mintAuthority.summary: eEARN is a UUPS USDC vault-share wrapper: current shares are minted against deposited USDC, base USDC issuance is inherited from Circle, and the local implementation can be replaced through the CTG One Governance timelock, whose proposer, executor, and canceller roles are each held by a single externally owned account behind a one-day delay. The dormant adapter-only bridge mint/burn surface is excluded from native Mint Authority and reviewed separately under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: Ember Earn eEARN vault share accounting
controls.capDescription: Wrapper share minting represents deposits into the eEARN vault and does not create base USDC supply.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770499, asset() returned USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, totalAssets() was 3,353,532.033822 USDC, totalSupply() was 3,237,549.738082 shares, maxTVL() was 10,000,000 USDC, and pauseStatus() reported all operations unpaused. The proxy's EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to current verified EmberVault 0x9b2e2eef7ffe1b15ca8c61e65538b51ca8977c7e while admin and beacon slots were zero; the current wrapper creates shares against deposited USDC rather than base USDC supply. Its bridgeMint and bridgeBurn functions are adapter-only, and bridgeAdapter() was zero at this observation, so those dormant representation capabilities are reviewed separately under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: eEARN CTG One Governance Timelock
controls.capDescription: The owner-authorized UUPS replacement path can alter local eEARN share-mint logic after the timelock delay.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770499, eEARN owner() returned CTGOneGovernance 0x12917e06b55995e7a5d73681ce491774c73b7c6a and UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION() returned 5.0.0. The current verified EmberVault source restricts _authorizeUpgrade to onlyOwner. The owner timelock's getMinDelay() returned 86400 seconds, and hasRole() confirmed the surviving single-EOA proposer, executor, and canceller assignments; the timelock itself holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. No Safe threshold or signer quorum bounds this UUPS upgrade path.

controls.label: eEARN timelock proposer (EOA)
controls.capDescription: Sole holder of PROPOSER_ROLE on the timelock that owns the eEARN UUPS proxy; can schedule an implementation replacement subject to the one-day delay.

sources.label: CTG One Governance Timelock role events

controls.evidence: RoleGranted at block 25295344 assigned PROPOSER_ROLE to this account, and hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE, 0x203d4cec...) returned true at block 25770499. Its CANCELLER_ROLE grant from the same block was revoked at block 25295346. eth_getCode at block 25770499 returned 0x, so the account is externally owned and no signer quorum bounds it.

controls.label: eEARN timelock executor (EOA)
controls.capDescription: Sole holder of EXECUTOR_ROLE on the timelock that owns the eEARN UUPS proxy; executes a scheduled implementation replacement once the one-day delay elapses.

sources.label: CTG One Governance Timelock role events

controls.evidence: RoleGranted at block 25295344 assigned EXECUTOR_ROLE to this account, and hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE, 0xa2160f1d...) returned true at block 25770499. eth_getCode at block 25770499 returned 0x, so the account is externally owned and no signer quorum bounds it.

controls.label: eEARN timelock canceller (EOA)
controls.capDescription: Sole holder of CANCELLER_ROLE on the timelock that owns the eEARN UUPS proxy; can cancel a scheduled operation but cannot schedule or execute one.

sources.label: CTG One Governance Timelock role events

controls.evidence: RoleGranted at block 25295345 assigned CANCELLER_ROLE to this account, and hasRole(CANCELLER_ROLE, 0x71aa7564...) returned true at block 25770499. eth_getCode at block 25770499 returned 0x, so the account is externally owned.

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-16 at Ethereum block 25770499. eEARN is a USDC strategy-vault variant and asset() confirms the current USDC backing; totalAssets() was 3,353,532.033822 USDC, totalSupply() was 3,237,549.738082 shares, maxTVL() was 10,000,000 USDC, and all vault operations were unpaused. The ERC-1967 proxy resolves to current verified EmberVault implementation 0x9b2e2eef7ffe1b15ca8c61e65538b51ca8977c7e with no external proxy-admin or beacon slot; owner() resolves to CTGOneGovernance 0x12917e06b55995e7a5d73681ce491774c73b7c6a, whose getMinDelay() is 86400 seconds. Current reads confirm single-EOA proposer, executor, and canceller roles with no signer quorum. The native review remains wrapper-scoped: deposited USDC mints local eEARN shares and does not create Circle USDC supply. bridgeAdapter() is zero; the latent adapter-only bridgeMint/bridgeBurn and its authorizable ProtocolConfig path are excluded from native Mint Authority and reviewed under Bridge Risk. The wrapper has no independent reserve-reconciliation evidence and no named financial regulator supervises the issuer, so supervision remains none.
